name: Golmud

queries.query: Golmud China official cadastral parcel map land resources GIS
queries.result: First-party search found the Golmud municipal government Natural Resources Bureau page and official public-land notices, but no public parcel viewer or anonymous parcel feature API.

queries.result: Official Golmud results identify the local Natural Resources Bureau and real-estate registration service center. A municipal notice documents QR-linked access to cadastral/map attachments, but no anonymous map/API route or parcel geometry was exposed.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and Chinese discovery plus bounded official-site and public-map configuration inspection
sourceReview: Golmud municipal government identifies the local Natural Resources Bureau as the custodian for natural-resources and real-estate registration information, with a local real-estate registration service-center window. An official notice states that QR codes on certificates can expose cadastral/map attachments. The official Qinghai Tianditu portal was identified as a public standard-map service, but its anonymous homepage request timed out during bounded inspection and no cadastral feature route, schema/CRS, safe parcel identity, or polygon response was obtained.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Golmud municipal government homepage was found. It provides government and public-service navigation; no public cadastral viewer link was identified in the bounded inspection.

Official Natural Resources Bureau institutional page loaded. It identifies responsibility for unified natural-resources and real-estate registration, information-platform management, and a local registration service-center contact. No viewer JavaScript, map configuration, feature API, schema, or geometry was exposed.

Official municipal news states that from January 2026 Golmud uses QR-linked real-estate certificates and that scanning can query core cadastral/map attachment information. This is local registry/procedure evidence, not anonymous parcel geometry evidence.

Official first-registration notice demonstrates active local land-and-building registration records and a local registration-window address. Owner and other unsafe fields were not requested or retained. No public parcel API was exposed.

Official Qinghai geographic-information public-service portal was identified by official Golmud correspondence and search. Anonymous HTTPS request timed out after 20 seconds; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS exception, or retry beyond the bounded request was attempted. A timeout is not evidence of cadastral absence.

A first-party provincial Tianditu portal was inspected only to understand the current public viewer/configuration pattern. Its configuration exposed standard basemap WMTS and generic map/service-management routes, not Golmud parcel data; it is outside Golmud/Qinghai and was not treated as a source.

Current JavaScript configuration was readable for the non-Golmud comparison portal. It exposed basemap/service-management configuration but no Golmud cadastral endpoint. No parcel request was issued against it.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: No Golmud/Qinghai cadastral viewer configuration or feature-service route was exposed in the bounded official inspection.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed; no parcel feature response was obtained.

uncertainty: Golmud local registry and natural-resources custodianship are evidenced by official municipal sources. Current public map/API availability, parcel geometry coverage, schema, CRS, stable native identity semantics, and anonymous access remain unverified. Runtime/admission remains held.
